title: PTNK Official Knowledge Atom
description: Canonical schema for promoted official knowledge. Official atoms contain downstream learning knowledge plus one provenance pointer back to the reviewed candidate.

id.description: Positional identifier in the official knowledge base. Use double underscores to separate recognizable components; the ID must not contain '/'.

knowledge_domain.description: High-level learning domain of the atom. This is distinct from atom_type, which describes the kind of knowledge represented.

pronunciation.description: Verified pronunciation, preferably in IPA. Leave blank when reliable evidence is not yet available; never guess.

part_of_speech.description: Part of speech when applicable and supported by the source; leave blank when not applicable or not yet verified.

definition.description: Source-provided definition preserved verbatim. Leave blank only when no reliable definition is available; do not paraphrase a definition that already exists in the source.

mother_says.description: Learner-facing Vietnamese meaning corresponding to the verified atom. Leave blank when not yet enriched.

examples.description: One or more source or explicitly marked enriched example sentences supporting the atom. Use an empty array when none is available.

patterns.description: Verified usage patterns genuinely associated with the atom. Use an empty array when none is available.

usage_note.description: Verified usage restriction, register, nuance, contrast, or other important usage note. Leave blank when not yet enriched.

candidate_ref.description: Pointer to the reviewed candidate record from which this official atom was promoted.
